issues.quote: Flutter's own code for the field calls `setState` in the field's own `State` when told
issues.text: The setState calls are in the States of widgets inside TextField (EditableTextState, the AnimatedBuilder's State); TextField's own State (_TextFieldState) does not listen to the controller. Claim 5 says "those widgets' own State"; the lesson does not.
issues.fix: Write: "Flutter's own code for those widgets calls `setState` in their own `State` when told, so your code never has to."

issues.quote: so the controller's own cleanup of its listener list never runs
issues.text: True but misleading as the reason: when the field leaves the tree, its inner widgets remove their own listeners in their dispose (editable_text.dart:3610), so the list is normally empty already. The docs give the reason only as "discard any resources used by the object".
issues.fix: Replace with "so whatever the controller's `dispose` does is skipped", or cite the docs' reason: dispose "discards any resources used by the object"; keep "and the Flutter docs ask for `dispose`...".

issues.quote: so whatever the controller's `dispose` does is skipped
issues.text: Core concepts told me what dispose does (empties the listener list, makes the controller unusable). 'Whatever ... does' makes me stop and wonder if there is more that the lesson hides. Small, but I re-read Core concepts to check.
issues.fix: Point back to Core concepts instead of 'whatever', e.g. 'so the cleanup described for `dispose` in Core concepts is skipped'.
